intro.title: Company Introduction
intro.content: Founded in 2018, WisCreation is a technology company focused on providing software solutions for enterprises. Our team consists of passionate and innovative technical experts dedicated to helping businesses achieve digital transformation through the power of technology.

history.title: Development History
history.milestone1: Our company was established in Shanghai, initially focusing on website development services for local businesses.
history.milestone2: As our business grew, we acquired our first major enterprise client and began offering a wider range of software development services.
history.milestone3: To meet the growing demand for mobile applications, we established a dedicated mobile app development team.
history.milestone4: We expanded our operations across Asia, opening offices in Beijing, Tokyo, and Singapore.
history.milestone5: We launched our own SaaS platform, providing scalable cloud solutions for small and medium-sized businesses.
history.milestone6: Our efforts were recognized as we were named an industry leader in software development and received multiple awards for technical innovation.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To help businesses grow through excellent digital solutions. We combine innovative approaches and the latest technologies to drive our clients' success.

team.title: Leadership Team
team.description: We firmly believe that teamwork is the key to success. We encourage open communication and diverse thinking to create outstanding results together.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: Our vision is to be a leader at the forefront of digital transformation, helping businesses stand out in competition and achieve growth.

services.title: Services & Products
services.subtitle: We provide comprehensive software development services and innovative cloud solutions

custom.description: Tailored software solutions based on your business needs, from requirement analysis and design to deployment and maintenance.

mobile.title: Mobile App Development
mobile.description: Professional mobile application development services supporting iOS and Android platforms to provide mobile solutions for your business.

security.title: Network Security Services
security.description: Comprehensive security protection for your systems and data, including security assessment, vulnerability scanning, and security hardening services.

enterprise.title: Enterprise Solutions
enterprise.description: Comprehensive enterprise-grade software solutions tailored to streamline operations and drive business growth.

data.title: Data Management
data.description: Advanced data solutions including big data processing, data warehousing, and business intelligence systems.

ai.title: AI & Machine Learning
ai.description: Cutting-edge AI solutions to automate processes, gain insights from data, and enhance decision-making.

case1.title: E-commerce Platform Transformation
case1.description: We helped a retail company transform their traditional business with a modern e-commerce platform, resulting in a 200% increase in online sales within six months.

case2.title: Enterprise Resource Planning System
case2.description: Developed a comprehensive ERP solution for a manufacturing company, integrating inventory management, production planning, and supply chain operations.

case3.title: Mobile Banking Application
case3.description: Created a secure and user-friendly mobile banking application for a financial institution, featuring biometric authentication and real-time transaction processing.

step1.title: Requirements Analysis
step1.description: We work closely with clients to understand their business goals and specific requirements.

step2.title: Planning & Design
step2.description: Our team creates detailed project plans and designs system architecture based on requirements.

step3.title: Development
step3.description: We follow agile development methodologies to ensure efficient and high-quality implementation.

step4.title: Testing & QA
step4.description: Comprehensive testing is performed to ensure software quality, security, and performance.

step5.title: Deployment
step5.description: We handle the deployment process with minimal disruption to your business operations.

step6.title: Maintenance & Support
step6.description: Ongoing support and maintenance to ensure your software remains up-to-date and secure.
